computation: Select records inside the declared segment region whose brake value is at or above the declared threshold, and take the along-lap distance of the last such record.
definition: The along-lap distance of the last record inside the declared segment whose brake value was at or above the declared threshold.
limitations: Later brake release is not automatically better; it may equally reflect a missed entry or an unsustainable line.
The value is quantized to the sampling resolution of the source and is not a continuous measurement of pedal release.
The metric is defined only relative to the declared threshold and segment region.
name: Segment brake-release distance
